subject: Copywriting
title: Framing: Same Fact, Different Feeling
description: A 60-second lesson on Framing: Same Fact, Different Feeling.

hook.text: '95% fat-free' outsells '5% fat.' Same yogurt, different frame. How you say it changes what people hear.

buildup.text: Tversky and Kahneman showed doctors chose differently based on framing. '90% survive' beat '10% die.' Same math.

discovery.text: Copy frames every claim. 'Save $50' vs 'Don't waste $50.' Gain frame vs loss frame—both true, different impact.

twist.text: Negative frames work better for prevention products. Positive frames work better for aspirational purchases.

climax.text: A skilled copywriter doesn't lie—they choose which truth to emphasize. Framing is selection, not deception.

punchline.text: Same fact, different words. Framing changes everything.
